originalText:
In 2024, our upload dialog showed pricing first and the supported file size at the bottom. I moved the limit above the price and grouped the next actions beside it. I kept the option to cancel. This was an editorial decision; we did not run a usability study or measure its effect on conversion.

Atlas Translate accepted files up to 12 MB at the time. I kept that limit visible before users chose whether to upgrade.
rewrittenText:
In 2024, our upload dialog led with pricing and buried the supported file size at the bottom. I changed the hierarchy: I moved the file limit above the price and grouped the next actions beside it, keeping the option to cancel intact.

At the time, Atlas Translate accepted files up to 12 MB. I kept that limit visible before people had to decide whether to upgrade.

This was an editorial call. We did not run a usability study, nor did we measure its effect on conversion.

Jargon is avoided in favor of direct, confident assertions, matching the craftsman profile's preference for tactile, unhurried prose.
